title: Beginner Gym
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A full-body, machine-based workout for beginners who want to build confidence and strength in the gym. Machines guide your movement, so you can learn proper form, find your starting weights, and train safely without needing to master complex barbell lifts. The workout covers every major muscle group: upper-body pushing and pulling with the chest press, lat pulldown, seated row, and shoulder press; legs with the leg press, leg extension, and leg curl; core with the ab crunch machine; and a glute finisher of kickbacks and cable pull-throughs. It's a solid foundation to build on as you get stronger.
